THE_HYPOTHESIS: Supplying a deterministic geometric role bit r_i removes the need for the policy to solve N/2 vs N/2 assignment implicitly. With π_θ(a_i | o_i, r_i), 4v4 Pole-B specialization (Δ_B) can improve where unaided entity-repair B failed — without hard-coding macros.

ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.distance: d_i = ||p_i - p_home||_2 Euclidean in the same continuous coordinates the core uses for agent positions
ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.p_home: own-team flag home / base for the controlled (blue) team
ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.pool: living agents only (dead / tagged-out agents receive no ATTACK/DEFEND bit for ranking; see dead_trigger)

rule.DEFEND: r_i = 0 for the closest k living agents by d_i
rule.ATTACK: r_i = 1 for the remaining living agents

ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.when_n_alive_less_than_k: assign DEFEND to all living agents (no fabricated attackers)
ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.ties: strictly deterministic: smaller agent index ranks as closer (wins DEFEND) when d_i equal
ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_locked.permutation: geometric ranking is invariant to observation-batch permutation of agents except for the frozen index tie-break

STABILITY_locked.mechanism: fixed reassignment period (not per-frame rerank; not adaptive hysteresis in v1)
STABILITY_locked.H_r_rationale: single exploratory hold length: long enough to stop N/2-boundary chatter, short enough to adapt. THIS IS NOT AN H_r SCREEN. Change only by written amendment before any training step that uses roles.
STABILITY_locked.hold: after an assignment event, keep each living agent's r_i fixed for H_r decision ticks
STABILITY_locked.dead_trigger: any death / revival that changes the living set triggers immediate reassignment (does not wait for the hold to expire)
STABILITY_locked.episode_start: assign at t=0 of each episode

POLICY_INTERFACE_locked.actor_path: r_i must be concatenated into agent i's actor input pathway (exact tensor join point named in implementation; contracts prove it affects logits)
POLICY_INTERFACE_locked.critic_path: critic receives the full team role vector (length N) so value is not blind to assignment; no separate role value head
